headline: Global semiconductor and tech stocks slide amid valuation and AI concerns
summary: Global chipmaker and semiconductor stocks fell sharply, with major Asian and US indexes suffering steep drops amid growing investor doubts over AI returns and rising borrowing costs.
why: Semiconductor companies design and manufacture the microchips that power modern electronics, cloud computing, and artificial intelligence infrastructure. They are bellwethers for the broader technology sector and global economic cyclicality.

impacts.name: Semiconductors
impacts.why: Weaker sentiment and growth questions regarding artificial intelligence investments directly pressure chip valuations.

why_moved: A combination of lofty AI infrastructure valuations, rising interest rate expectations, and cautious earnings guidance triggered aggressive profit-taking and liquidations across global tech shares.
